title: 英国新财相承诺财政纪律，力推区域增长
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: So you know, then the past week, this new job has taken me from my home constituency in South Yorkshire to the G20 meeting in North Carolina.
segments.zh: 过去一周，这份新工作让我从南约克郡的选区来到了北卡罗来纳州的G20会议。

segments.en: And there I was proud to have behind me the work, begun by Kia Stammer, to reestablish Britain as a respected voice among our allos, and the work begun by Rachel Reeves to recover Britain's fiscal discipline.
segments.zh: 在那里，我为基尔·斯塔默开始的工作感到自豪，他重新确立了英国在盟友中的受尊重声音；也为雷切尔·里夫斯开始的工作感到自豪，她恢复了英国的财政纪律。

segments.en: I will build on both as Chancellor. I am determined that the next chapter of Britain's growth story will be written in more places, and that's not sentimentality, that is supply side economics.
segments.zh: 作为财政大臣，我将在这两项工作基础上继续努力。我决心让英国增长故事的下一章在更多地方书写，这不是感伤，而是供给侧经济学。

segments.en: A transport bottleneck in South Yorkshire is too often invisible from Whitehall, but it can have a real impact on economic growth and on business investment decisions.
segments.zh: 南约克郡的交通瓶颈在白厅往往被忽视，但它可能对经济增长和企业**决策产生实际影响。

segments.en: That's why at the budget, I will set out a roadmap to fiscal devolution, a permanent transfer of power and resources from Whitehall to our regions.
segments.zh: 因此，在预算中，我将制定财政权力下放的路线图，将权力和资源从白厅永久转移到各地区。

segments.en: With greater business rates retention for local councils and strategic authorities, grants from central government replaced by a share of local income tax for every mayoral strategic authority beginning in 2028.
segments.zh: 通过提高地方议会和战略当局的商业税率留存，从2028年开始，中央政府的拨款将被每个市长战略当局的地方所得税份额所取代。
